PaintFE v1.4.9

This update fixes several editing problems and makes Preferences and dialog controls easier to use.

Bug fixes

- Text shortcuts now stay with the text editor instead of affecting the canvas underneath.
- Fixed stale pixels appearing after undoing or redoing a crop.
- Layer settings now update when switching layers or documents.
- Pasted images remain editable while navigating and commit when switching to a painting tool.
- Fixed selection size reporting, Windows paths in Document Info and alignment in Recent Files.
- Improved resize input, canvas anchor previews and reset behaviour.
- Fixed numeric controls moving Save As or Preferences while dragging.
- Fixed the Preferences layout so search stays compact and settings remain visible.

Features and improvements

- Search Preferences using English or your selected language.
- Customise the bottom-right image information panel's font size, opacity, text colour and background colour under Interface → Advanced Customization.
- Type or drag the Save As preview zoom percentage directly.

Validation

- 590 tests passed, none failed and 8 optional or manual tests were skipped.
- Tests ran in small sequential batches.
- Clippy, build, formatting and translation checks passed.
- Live checks covered Preferences search, layout, appearance controls and light and dark themes.

Related issues: 168, 185, 186, 188, 189, 190, 191, 192 and 193.
These remain open so users can test and confirm the changes. Further testing is continuing.
